sn18.4:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Taṃ kiṃ maññasī Rāhula || || Cakkhusamphasso nicco vā anicco vāti || Anicco bhante || || Sotasamphasso || Ghānasamphasso || Jivhāsamphasso || kāyasamphasso || Manosamphasso nicco vā anicco vāti || || Anicco bhante || || Evam passaṃ Rāhula sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusamphassasmim pi nibbindati || sotasamphassasmim pi || ghānasamphassasmim pi || jivhāsamphassasmiṃ pi || kāyasamphassasmim pi || manosamphassasmim pi nibbindati || || Nibbindaṃ virajati || pe|| || pajānātīti || || Catutthaṃ || ||
